test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Match the columns.

 
 

 
 **Instruments**
 
 **Their Function**
 
 

 i.
 Voltmeter
 a.
 An instrument that measures the magnitude of the current
 
 

 ii.
 Ammeter
 b.
 An instrument that measures voltage
 
 

 iii.
 Galvanometer
 c.
 An instrument that measures resistance
 
 

 iv.
 Ohmmeter
 d.
 An instrument that measures the direction and the magnitude of the current

options.text: i - a, ii - c, iii - b, iv - d
i - b, ii - a, iii - d, iv - c
i - b, ii - a, iii - c, iv - d
i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d

solution:
The correct answer is __**i - b, ii - a, iii - d, iv - c **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• An ohmmeter is an electrical device used to measure resistance.
 
• Ammeter is an instrument for measuring the current flowing in a branch of a circuit.
 
• Voltmeter is a measuring instrument used to measure the potential difference between any two points of a circuit.
 
• Galvanometer is used to detect the presence of current in a circuit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Instruments**
 **Quantity Measured**
 
 

 **Ammeter**
 Electric Current
 
 

 **Voltmeter**
 Electric potential, voltage
 
 

 **Galvanometer**
 Electricity
 
 

 **Altimeter**
 Altitudes
 
 

 **Bolometer**
 Electromagnetic Radiation
 
 

 **Barometer**
 Air Pressure
 
 

 **Hygrometer**
 Humidity
